notes.title: Build Update 6/15
notes.notes:
We've made some improvements to the movement of held objects.

Please continue to share your comments and suggestions, and as always, thanks for playing.

notes.title: Build Update 1/21
notes.notes:
Thanks to all our players for your constructive feedback.  We've been listening to you and working to iron out bugs and give you the best experience possible.  This build update contains the following changes:


 Improved networking to reduce the incidence of players getting dropped from online sessions, and to make it easier to rejoin sessions in case a player is dropped.
Fixed "From Me Two You" achievement bugs.
Fixed multiplayer door opening bug.
Added lever to top of elevator puzzle (in "Four Whom the Bell Tolls") so players don't have to redo the puzzle if a player is dropped or leaves.
Added hidden notes.
Increased tutorial text size.
Adjusted reflections to reduce visual artifacts.


Please continue to share your feedback, and watch out for new content coming in the future.

notes.title: Build Update 9/21 - New 2 Player Level
notes.notes:
We've added a new level to WEscape!  The level From Me Two You is for 2 players and focuses on cooperation and communication.

In addition to the new level, we fixed some minor issues with character movement and sound effects.

As always, we encourage feedback from the community so that we can continue to improve WEscape.

notes.title: Build Update 8/20
notes.notes:
WEscape has been updated with the following changes:


Fixed bug which prevented players from earning "I'll Wipe My Own Tears" and "The Elite Four" achievements.
Added animation for character turning in place.
Improved block movement and made buckets larger in ball bouncing puzzle.
Increased wait penalty for wrong guesses on picture difference puzzle.
Other small puzzle tweaks.
Fixed some lighting issues.
